calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id < 900 AS is_store, s.store_id = 999 AS is_training, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.channel_code, f.vat_rate,
  CASE WHEN f.sale_date < DATE '2024-09-01' THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END AS vat_era,
  count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_ids,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat,
  sum(round(f.net_amount * f.vat_rate, 2)) AS vat_calc, min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH st AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM st) AS n_lines,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM st GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS date_mismatch,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE abs(gross_amount - net_amount * (1 + vat_rate)) > 0.02) AS gross_not_matching,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE vat_rate IS NULL OR gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL) AS nulls,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM st) AS etl_loads,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE net_amount <= 0) AS nonpositive,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE staff_purchase_flag) AS staff_lines,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM st) AS stores,
  (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM st) AS net_sales_before_returns,
  (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id < 900) AS rpt_net_before_returns

SELECT 'refunds_by_return_date' AS what, r.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_net) AS net, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) AS vat
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'class_mismatch_' || p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*), sum(f.net_amount), sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1, 2

calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, f.vat_rate * 100 AS vat_rate_pct,
       SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC
